title: Gate pipeline handoffs and recover interrupted/reworked stages
description: Implement revision-checked transitions, parallel joins, check and approval requirements, changed-upstream invalidation and rebuild-from-stage lineage. Pipeline cards coordinate deliverables but do not form an independently scheduled task queue.
acceptanceCriteria: Next stage cannot consume unchecked or unapproved required inputs
Concurrent and replayed transitions are safe; upstream changes invalidate dependent evidence
Interrupted/rejected work remains traceable and cannot double-start or falsely complete
